title: Two alcove wardrobes, one around the boiler
summary: Tall wardrobes in both alcoves of a bedroom: one with a rail and shelves, the other built around the boiler.
intro: A bedroom with a chimney breast and an alcove either side. One alcove got a hanging wardrobe with shelves above the rail. The other had the boiler on the wall, so that wardrobe is built around it: narrow shelves down one side and the boiler behind the other door, with room left round it for servicing. Both have panelled doors made with applied moulding, built in MDF ready for painting.
